card.name: Government and national institution context
card.fires_on: Words inside phrases about governments, national bodies or official rules, such as 'issued by the' before 'state government', 'United States', or 'Federal, State'. It fires where a national or official agency is expected next.

modes.description: Linking words or country names just ahead of a state, federal or national authority.

modes.label: Inside official names and rules
modes.description: Parts of national organization names or regulatory phrases such as licensing, standards and regulation.

modes.description: Names within lists of countries, states or agencies.
modes.example: In the United<< States>>, United Kingdom, Mexico, New Zealand

card.writes: It suppresses names of national agencies like NASA, USDA and Smithsonian, and promotes local or 'same city' words, so it pushes away from naming a national body.
